title: Delphimi settlement and the Sunder Compact
chronology_label: 0 S.M.
chronology_note: The old tyrannical order falls; Crown and Commonwealth are joined into a divided constitutional state, and the Sunder Moon becomes the era's emblem.

title: Silver Night: west-tower deaths
chronology_label: Before the Last Seven's opening; exact calendar date unknown
chronology_note: Thirty-six students and six servants die in a deliberate disaster. Ilyan knows his father and uncle were responsible; not an accident and not evidence of royal complicity.

title: Rome becomes king; Daysha already his queen
chronology_label: 1 Thawcall, 282 S.M. — working accession, wedding, conception
chronology_note: Rome's first regnal year begins. The wedding and conception are synchronized to this day for the royal-family planning model; his Avariel genealogy remains unresolved.

title: Beneath Dappled Oaks opens in Rome's first year
chronology_label: 14 Deepdelve, 282 S.M. — working midpoint of Rome's first regnal year
chronology_note: Beneath Dappled Oaks opens while Estelle remains unborn, 85 days before her projected birth; Rome and Daysha reign in Elaranth.

title: The Last Seven probe Silver Night's institutional record
chronology_label: Following opening, during Book One; individual chapters have separate causal order
chronology_note: Witness screens, mnemonic plates, memory salt and conflicting written records become evidence, not instant proof that every suspect is guilty.

title: Chapter Thirty: lawful remedies versus interference records
chronology_label: After the earlier Last Seven investigations; exact day not fixed
chronology_note: The lawful concentration review, Edrin Salver's administrative path and the interference record can be compared, without convicting Salver or proving every causal link.

title: Northern Felridge displacement and military inquiry

chronology_label: Undated; specific missions not yet promoted to story canon

title: Princess Estelle's sixteenth birthday
chronology_label: 15 Casktide, 298 S.M. — projected sixteenth birthday

title: Luceran inherits the Embar-Zara crown
chronology_label: Before Season 1's Edselsto move; local year unestablished
chronology_note: After his parents' deaths, King Luceran inherits a legally valid but politically insecure monarchy.

title: Court returns to Castle Edselsto
chronology_label: Season 1, early
chronology_note: The young king moves from the compromised capital to the decaying ancestral seat, unknowingly atop an ancient prison.

title: The first-season coup and Edselsto's awakening
chronology_label: Season 1 finale
chronology_note: The coup fails, the castle opens its gates and becomes audibly, dangerously useful to its living monarch.

title: The eastern treasury and institutional custody conflict
chronology_label: Season 2 Episode 5
chronology_note: Luceran's court uncovers the Eastern Household Reserve; the contents are not all Crown-owned, and lawful spending requires separating claims.

title: The castle's privacy and listening crises
chronology_label: Season 2, after treasury discovery
chronology_note: Useful supernatural hearing prompts legal and personal boundaries, including the king's misuse of an intimate private conversation.

title: The seven candles fall and the final coalition fights
chronology_label: Seasons 3–5: planned macro arc, not all completed prose
chronology_note: The geode prison and the original Nowhere King threaten Edselsto. Candle extinguishing and the final coalition are outline structure, not a completed historical ledger.

title: Charles deploys the Q-MAP team
chronology_label: Campaign prologue; far-future exact date unknown
chronology_note: Charles sends operatives to a far-future mirror universe without ordinary Blacklight infrastructure or a verified return route.

title: Awakening aboard the Ar'nock derelict
chronology_label: Beginning of play, after Q-MAP deployment
chronology_note: The team awakens in newly printed bodies aboard an Ar'nock vessel in the Gloam Concord; their capabilities come from explicitly established mechanics.

title: Martiken's Menagerie is in the setting
chronology_label: Undated source lore
chronology_note: Martiken's mutable shop and transformation business are established campaign locations and services; no calendar event is inferred.

title: Second Friday: two more gowns

title: The royal procession of dress boxes
chronology_label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown
chronology_note: The couple depart The Gilded Spindle, Garrick consults his ledger, and servants carry boxed gowns.

title: Daysha's first birthday as queen and Lexi's arrival
chronology_label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown
chronology_note: A royal-blue-and-gold birthday gown is made under a deadline; a servant presents Lexi, the first appearance of the star-furred celestial Maine Coon.

title: The unfinished-gown double purchase
chronology_label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown
chronology_note: The Friday after the birthday, Daysha loves the unembellished powder-blue gown and insists on an adjacent unfinished white-and-pink dress.

title: A self-funded Sunday purchase
chronology_label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown
chronology_note: Daysha returns without Rome or Lexi and buys the royal-blue-and-gold gown using the royal purse.

title: Fine cloth without gemstones
chronology_label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown
chronology_note: A pearlescent enchanted scale gown and teal filigree offering teach the artisans that Daysha loves immaculate craft even when the cloth carries no gems.

title: The easy enchanted gown
chronology_label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown
chronology_note: A simpler midnight/periwinkle-blue gown with restrained filigree and long draped sleeves delights the queen and lightens the seamstresses' workload.

title: The visiting master seamstress
chronology_label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown
chronology_note: A seamstress from abroad prepares the spectacular ocean-themed gown; the atelier also offers black/teal gold-embroidered finery.

title: The Queen Mother's first appearance
chronology_label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown
chronology_note: Daysha and Rome's mother visit without Rome or Lexi. The Queen Mother insists on the suitability of a rich blue gemstone-adorned dress.

title: Daysha returns the gift
chronology_label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown
chronology_note: Daysha chooses a luxurious lavender and pink ballgown for her mother-in-law; uniquely, the supplied design is worn by the Queen Mother.

title: Matching gowns for two queens
chronology_label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown
chronology_note: The women shop without Rome or Lexi and wear the same design in blue-white for Daysha, brilliant red-white for the Queen Mother.

title: The star-lit gown and Rome's admiration
chronology_label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown
chronology_note: Later that weekend Daysha wears a starry deep-blue and icy-blue gown; Rome becomes adorably flustered.

title: The Queen Mother's birthday commission
chronology_label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown
chronology_note: Daysha commissions a light-blue royal event gown with a handful of special valuable stones, blending her love of fine simplicity and her mother-in-law's love of gems.

title: The royal jewel delivery chase
chronology_label: After Estelle's first-year birth; later childhood date unknown
chronology_note: Daysha and daughter Estelle chase a jewel delivery later revealed to be intended for the Queen Mother.

title: Palace garden tea and royal daycare
chronology_label: After Estelle's first-year birth; later childhood date unknown
chronology_note: The family shares pastries; Estelle visits royal daycare.

title: Estelle's glitter balloon prank
chronology_label: After Estelle's first-year birth; later childhood date unknown
chronology_note: Estelle pelts Rome with a glitter-filled water balloon while ministers laugh; a corrected bursting-balloon illustration is approved.

title: Family catroom and magical cleanup
chronology_label: After Estelle's first-year birth; later childhood date unknown
